newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sends further food aid to famine-hit N. Korea.
newsitem.headline: EU sends further food aid to famine-hit N. Korea.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it had approved the urgent supply of a further 24,000 tonnes of maize and 10,000 tonnes of rice to famine-stricken North Korea.
Commission officials said the food aid would be distributed through the U.N. World Food Programme and a tender to supply an extra 20,000 tonnes of rice would be launched on August 20.
Drought has devastated maize and rice harvests in North Korea, sharply worsening food shortages caused by floods during the past two years.
Humanitarian aid groups say an estimated 80,000 children in North Korea are severely malnourished and in danger of dying from starvation or disease.
Aid groups and North Korean officials estimate that 800,000 tonnes of food is needed between now and the end of October.
The EU aid is part of a 46.3 million Ecus famine relief programme of 155,000 tonnes of food products, notably rice, maize and vegetable oils.
